items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'What boat?' he said, 'Julie Belle Swain,' I nearly fell down. Because later this Mel Hewlitt and the Skinner boys worked on that same boat.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, fella said, 'Come down and I'll take you around the city, and I said, 'What boat?' he said, 'Julie Belle Swain,' I nearly fell down. Because later this Mel Hewlitt and the Skinner boys worked on that same boat.
